title: Dartmouth College Provost's Undisclosed AI-Assisted Writing Was Found to Have Breached Publication Policies
summary: A faculty review at Dartmouth College in Hanover, New Hampshire, found that provost Santiago Schnell used ChatGPT and Claude in published writing without required disclosure and fell short of institutional standards. The review examined AI logs and correspondence rather than detector scores. Schnell resigned and was leaving the college after the findings were released.
